assets.name: Wordmark, app mark, 2–3 directions
assets.creation_or_source: Original vector design after name selection
assets.deliverable_budget_proposal: SVG/source, monochrome, small-size and Android adaptive icon layers
assets.acceptance_and_rights: Originality review, editable masters, author/provenance; legible without complex texture

assets.name: UI font
assets.creation_or_source: Barlow candidate from official author repository [1]
assets.deliverable_budget_proposal: Selected TTF/OTF weights and license; part of 1–2 MiB initial font budget
assets.acceptance_and_rights: Verify downloaded license/files; check I/l/1, O/0, punctuation, long titles and required languages

assets.name: Numeric font
assets.creation_or_source: IBM Plex Mono candidate from IBM upstream [2], or tabular UI font
assets.deliverable_budget_proposal: Required files only, license and fallback metrics
assets.acceptance_and_rights: Acquisition/license verification pending; readable time/BPM at actual size

assets.name: General icons, about 60–90
assets.creation_or_source: One coherent Lucide subset [3] or selected native symbol family
assets.deliverable_budget_proposal: SVG masters and native vector conversions
assets.acceptance_and_rights: Preserve ISC/MIT notices where applicable; consistent stroke/grid; accessible names

assets.name: DJ symbols, about 25–40
assets.creation_or_source: Original vectors matching selected icons
assets.deliverable_budget_proposal: Slip, beatjump, sync, phase, cue/memory, stem, bus, tempo-bend symbols
assets.acceptance_and_rights: DJ comprehension review; no copied competitor iconography or embedded brand logos

assets.name: Dial family
assets.creation_or_source: Original procedural native geometry
assets.deliverable_budget_proposal: Gain/EQ/filter/pitch controls, states, size variants, unit/value rules
assets.acceptance_and_rights: Real interactive components; legibility at 48/64/80dp; no baked text or bitmap per value

assets.name: Faders and transport
assets.creation_or_source: Original native component family
assets.deliverable_budget_proposal: Crossfader/channel rail, thumb, play/cue/stop, assigned/disabled/pressed states
assets.acceptance_and_rights: Distinct hit bounds, captured pointers, clear active deck, accessible alternatives

assets.name: Pads and XY surface
assets.creation_or_source: Original components
assets.deliverable_budget_proposal: Empty/loaded/held/pending/playing/edit/error states, bank badges
assets.acceptance_and_rights: Engine acknowledgement reflected honestly; labels and units; momentary/latch visibility

assets.name: Brass and titanium material recipes
assets.creation_or_source: Procedural formulas; original small texture if needed

assets.acceptance_and_rights: No unlicensed photo crops; no seams; bounded GPU/memory cost

assets.name: Glass materials, 3 tiers
assets.creation_or_source: Original native recipes and optional shader
assets.deliverable_budget_proposal: Enhanced source, Balanced recipe, opaque Essential fallback
assets.acceptance_and_rights: No refractive text; worst-content contrast; visual tier cannot change musical functionality

assets.name: Waveforms
assets.creation_or_source: Derived from actual audio analysis
assets.deliverable_budget_proposal: Versioned multiresolution peak format and renderer fixtures
assets.acceptance_and_rights: Correct duration/channel/peak mapping; never a stock bar animation

assets.name: Beat/phrase/cue markers
assets.creation_or_source: Original vector geometry
assets.deliverable_budget_proposal: Active, pending, edited, uncertain and disabled styles

assets.name: Meters

assets.deliverable_budget_proposal: Master/cue/channel scales and clipping/limiter states
assets.acceptance_and_rights: Documented units and ballistics from DSP contract; not decorative gauges

assets.name: FX and stem symbols
assets.creation_or_source: Original concise vector family
assets.deliverable_budget_proposal: Effect identifiers, axis cues, vocal/drum/bass/other controls
assets.acceptance_and_rights: Parameter names still written; restricted/unready states cannot resemble ready controls

assets.name: Album-art placeholders, 8–12 patterns
assets.creation_or_source: Original deterministic procedural/vector patterns

assets.name: Haptic profiles

assets.deliverable_budget_proposal: WAV masters, playback versions, metadata and license

assets.name: Factory loops, about 12
assets.creation_or_source: Original production or expressly licensed commission
assets.deliverable_budget_proposal: BPM/key/bar metadata, masters, loop seam ground truth
assets.acceptance_and_rights: Typical sample-pack purchase may not permit app redistribution; verify exact terms

assets.name: Demo tracks, about 6–8
assets.creation_or_source: Original commission/production
assets.deliverable_budget_proposal: Full mix, authored stems, cue/beatgrid reference and rights declaration

assets.name: Help and rehearsal content

assets.acceptance_and_rights: Audio/product review; no mandatory onboarding or claims of mastery from assisted completion

assets.name: Optional store and promotional assets

assets.deliverable_budget_proposal: Editable masters and selected-channel exports only if pursued
assets.acceptance_and_rights: Not a personal-release gate; depict actual shipped behavior and record music/font/likeness rights

assets.name: Optional 3D hero scene
assets.creation_or_source: Original modeled or generated concept, then validated
assets.deliverable_budget_proposal: Editable scene, optimized stills; GLB only if a justified use exists

assets.name: ParDay assistant identity and states
assets.creation_or_source: Original compact mark, word treatment and UI icon family
assets.deliverable_budget_proposal: Editable vector/source; small-button, proposal, offline, pending, applied and error states; optional nonlive illustration
assets.acceptance_and_rights: ParDay is the assistant, not a final app name; no copied provider marks or implied endorsement; no obstructive live mascot

assets.name: A/C art-direction comparison
assets.creation_or_source: Two comparable generated raster concepts using Document 04 common brief
assets.deliverable_budget_proposal: Comparable landscape performance studies with the same fictional tracks, separate materials and exact saved prompts; layouts are not pixel matched.
assets.acceptance_and_rights: Record actual generated outputs and provenance after generation; illustrative only; not native implementation, audio data, source permission or performance verification
known_limitations: Control placement differs between A and C
A repeats Gain label and lacks visible tempo faders
Full EQ and all requirements not represented
Illustrated waveform and meters are not audio-derived or calibrated
Actual native hit bounds and contrast not measured

assets.name: Video/karaoke validation media
assets.creation_or_source: Original or expressly authorized video, timed captions and audio
assets.deliverable_budget_proposal: Short clips, caption timing ground truth, clean program-output and preview examples
assets.acceptance_and_rights: Recording/composition/video/caption rights checked separately; no ripped catalogue video or borrowed lyrics; no unsupported display depicted as qualified

assets.name: Link acquisition interface states and icons
assets.creation_or_source: Original native components and vectors using selected C Crystal Current tokens
assets.deliverable_budget_proposal: Local-first paste/share entry, exact-version matching, source and format/quality comparison, on-device download queue, expired-link/retry/cancel, validating, ready and failed states; editable masters and accessible labels. Optional AWS execution configuration is a later extension.
assets.acceptance_and_rights: Document 16 job states map to truthful status; actual source and declared/measured quality distinguished; no invented progress or codec quality; no provider endorsement; critical performance controls remain accessible
